† 1. भाज् भाज्, i. 10, Par. To divide; cf. भज्.
2. ऽभाज् -भाज्, (vb. भज्), latter part of comp. adj. One who possesses or obtains; e. g. अर्ध- adj. Obtaining or entitled to a half,

. विभाग-, m. Entitled to a portion of a property already distributed, as a son born after the distribution of his father's property. वियोग-, adj. Suffering separation, cf. also Pañc. i. d. 196; 147, 12.

भाजन, भज् + अन, n.
 1. Any vessel, as a pot or cup, Hit. pr. d. 8, M.M.; figuratively, Pañc. ii. d. 194 (a vessel of love and confidence, a person on whom one may depend).
 2. A fit person.
 3. Sharing.
 --Comp.
भाजन + त्व, n. Condition of being a vessel, i. e. a fit object, Mālav. d. 83.
